headline: Linn Mercy Now Wholly Colonial; Stonecradle Losses Mount
war_summary: Since the last edition, the Linn Mercy ledger has turned: no Warden-held strongpoint remains, and the sector now reports eleven Colonial posts to none. Heaviest recent activity was at Lathair. Stonecradle remains divided six Colonial to three Warden; no fresh base event appears in the latest two-hour interval, but two-hour casualties run high on both sides. Weathered Expanse is still the busiest sector, with twenty-two recorded base events over the past day and a five-to-four Colonial edge, although no base event has been logged in the most recent two hours. Dead Lands, wholly Colonial, stirred again around Callahan's Gate in the last six hours before quieting. Stlican Shelf is unchanged at six Warden to three Colonial, and Mooring County stands all Warden at twelve posts after a day of sharp losses. Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line continue to grind heavily with fixed lines. No victor has been declared.
